o: The scissors are on the table.
The scissors is on the table.
A scissors is on the table.
The scissor are on the table.
questions.e: দুই অংশবিশিষ্ট জিনিস (scissors, trousers, spectacles) সবসময় plural; একক বোঝাতে a pair of।
questions.src: Lecture 08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: Which of the following nouns is uncountable?
questions.e: furniture uncountable — a piece of furniture; furnitures হয় না।
questions.src: Lecture 08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

o: He gave me a piece of advice.
questions.src: Lecture 08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

o: The polices have arrested the thief.
The police has arrested the thief.
A police has arrested the thief.
The police have arrested the thief.
questions.src: Lecture 08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: Which noun is always used in the plural?
questions.e: trousers সবসময় plural; information, luggage, poetry uncountable singular।
questions.src: Lecture 08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

o: I need an information about the course.
I need some information about the course.
I need informations about the course.
I need many information about the course.
questions.e: information uncountable — some/much/a piece of information।

questions.q: Which of the following is a neuter gender noun?
questions.e: জড়বস্তু = neuter gender; teacher, child, cousin common gender।
questions.src: Lecture 08 ও Standard Grammar Reference (Wren & Martin; Oxford Learner's Dictionary)

questions.q: 'Honesty is the best policy.' — Here 'Honesty' is a/an—
questions.e: গুণ বা অবস্থার নাম — abstract noun।
